summary: Comprehensive testing of Training Arc V3.1 features - all 18 backend tests passed, frontend threshold and chamber flows working correctly. Training Level Tracker, Context Compression Engine, Field Attunement Scoring, Canonical Moment Explorer, and Threshold Sight all functional.

issues: Threshold Sight UI only displays when user has permanent MRA history (has_history=true). This is correct behavior but may confuse new users who expect to see something.

Attunement scoring tracks AI's ability to notice things before MRA flags them
Threshold Sight correctly injects field profile into Ansel's greeting context
All three presences (jasmine, ansel, claude) have independent training state tracking
